The artifacts, which were discovered in the Cydonia region of Mars, bear an uncanny resemblance to ancient human artifacts.
They are believed to be approximately 500,000 years old, predating human civilization on Earth.
The objects are composed of an unknown metal alloy, and inscribed with symbols that are eerily similar to ancient hieroglyphics.
The ISA has assembled a team of linguists, archaeologists, and astrophysicists to decipher these symbols and unlock the secrets they hold.
The discovery has sparked theories suggesting a connection between ancient human civilizations and extraterrestrial life.
